breakdown.description: At the inlet, the specified phase volume fractions do not sum to 1 (e.g., alpha.air is set to 1.0 while alpha.catalyst is nonzero), which over-constrains the Euler–Euler phase fraction fields.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that the phase volume fractions must sum to 1. It adjusted the values to `alpha.catalyst = 0.01` and `alpha.air = 0.99`, which correctly sum to 1, thereby resolving the over-constrained inlet condition.
